page.content:
Chooser-maidens who bring the slain to Odin and Freyja.

How Valkyries connects

  • Location: Valhalla — Valkyries bring the slain into Valhalla.
  • Character: Freyja — Freyja claims half the slain the Valkyries choose.

What is Valkyries?

The Valkyries ride over battlefields, allot death, and serve mead in Valhalla. Named figures such as Brynhild and Sigrdrifa stand at the edge of heroic legend.

Key threads lead to Valhalla and Freyja.
